snippet.title: Finger Slayer Wild part - 1
snippet.description:
Finger Slayer Wild promises to be a hot new addictive game which will storm the iTunes App Store charts quickly and become popular among its fans and gamers.  Finger Slayer Wild builds on the success of the original Finger Slayer, by introducing 3 new modes Shark, Lion and Bat.  

Download today by clicking here.
http://itunes.apple.com/us/app/finger-slayer-wild/id441920300?mt=8&ls=1
